name: RG202621
tagline: Industrial-strength heating in a compact freestanding design
description: The Thermozel Askio is a high-performance steel wood stove designed for efficiency and durability in smaller spaces. Featuring a robust 5mm thick steel chassis and a primary combustion chamber lined with high-density firebricks, it provides rapid heat distribution and steady thermal release. Its clean, square lines and large ceramic glass window offer a modern take on the traditional log burner, making it an ideal choice for cabins, workshops, or compact urban living rooms.
features: Heat-retaining firebrick lining for improved thermal mass
Precision air intake control for adjustable burn rates
Air-wash system to keep the ceramic glass clear of soot
Removable internal ash drawer for clean and easy disposal
